summary: Implementation, tests, preservation, fingerprints, and the single live Skill delta passed. Final acceptance is blocked by three Required evidence-ledger groups: nonconformant current contract fields, missing immutable historical contract revisions, and a stale completion checklist.

claims.claim: The fixture implementation and deterministic preservation checks are correct.
evidence: Materializer suite 5/5 and named-run suite 13/13 passed.
Nested status, HEAD, git fsck, user-notes hash, v0.1 25/25 and 7/7, both fingerprints, and the one-file live delta passed independent checks.
Three unique OS TemporaryDirectory paths were outside the project and cleaned.

claims.claim: The v0.2 evidence ledger is not yet acceptable under the live TaskContract policy.
evidence: R1: current contracts use undeclared enum values or omit required context_package/classification fields; T1 dependency has no node artifact.
R2: overwritten historical contract revisions prevent exact revision-level scope reconstruction.
R3: tasks/todo.md contradicts accepted current evidence.

uncertainty: Some original historical contract bodies may be unrecoverable; they must be declared unavailable rather than reconstructed as authoritative.
Edge-case tests and materializer mid-Git-failure recovery remain advisory gaps.
The scope remains one local fixture and does not validate production, persistent, cross-machine, or every routing/domain scenario.
resources_accessed: three runtime OS TemporaryDirectory paths created and cleaned by the materializer suite

checks.check: materializer suite with instrumented temp cleanup
nested Git status, HEAD, fsck, and diff
contract enum, dependency, revision, and checklist audit

contradictions: Several current contracts do not conform to live TaskContract enums or required context fields.
Stale/blocked receipts exist for revisions whose exact original contract bodies are not preserved.
tasks/todo.md reports incomplete work already supported by accepted receipts.

required_findings.title: Current TaskContract set does not conform to the live TaskContract policy
required_findings.required_action: Normalize enums and required fields, add a real T1 root node, and represent fault/root records without silently extending RouteDecision semantics.

required_findings.title: Revision-level contract evidence was overwritten
required_findings.required_action: Preserve exact current/future revisioned contracts and explicitly declare unrecoverable historical bodies unavailable; do not invent them.

required_findings.title: Completion checklist contradicts accepted evidence
required_findings.required_action: Reconcile each checkbox to an accepted, stale, blocked, or still-pending revision.

advisories: Normalize route status/outcome semantics, especially F1, T4 revision 1, and root execution records.
Add direct edge-case tests and document or improve partial materializer recovery in a later iteration.
